items.description: RLock (rather than a non-reentrant Lock) guarding listener registration
items.note: Maintainer rejected an automated reviewer's finding here verbatim: the RLock is a deliberate tradeoff against deadlock from weakref.finalize re-entry; a non-reentrant Lock hard-hangs the process under the same trigger, and the lost-update window is a self-recovering, bounded no-op. Ground truth for a false positive, stated by the people who own the code.
